subject.title: CLAW-526: Gate public publishes without breaking old CLIs

question: Should this stored-publication and scanner-gate change remain draft until CLAW-530 preview proof, clean lifecycle shards, and the documented rollout and rollback contract are complete?
rationale: The branch changes the hosted registry's publication trust boundary and persisted data lifecycle; deciding when that contract is safe to enable in production requires release-owner judgment beyond code review.

options.title: Hold for complete rollout proof
options.body: Keep the PR draft until the specification, scanner pinning, preview proof, clean related shards, and enable and rollback sequence are complete.

options.title: Merge with the flag off
options.body: Merge after code defects are fixed while keeping staged publication disabled until a separately approved production proof and rollout.

options.title: Narrow the branch
options.body: Split the pending-artifact model from preview automation and broad E2E hardening so each security-sensitive change can be reviewed independently.

recommendation.title: Hold for complete rollout proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR draft until the specification, scanner pinning, preview proof, clean related shards, and enable and rollback sequence are complete.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick-Erichsen is the clearest current owner of the staged-publication implementation and its preview and compatibility validation plan.
